msg: Re-audit: sanctioned paths closed. Rule 1b checks the raw value against an allowlist that already excludes everything _tic_esc would strip (tic.sh:17-20, tics-mcp.cjs:206-210). Readers compare from by exact match, so Run-Suite is not treated as a hook. session/scope are escaped. CONCERN: an older host (<=0.71.0) on a shared git bus can still publish via the CR/LF forge, giving a clean from=run-suite line that hasDupTopKey cannot catch, so ADR Consequences line 62 ('mixed-version buses are protected by the read side') overclaims. Either refuse hook identities in git-bus lines at the reader (ADR 0026 keeps them off the bus) with a test, or narrow the wording.
